cond_0492.intro: This position performs general maintenance of equipment in a regulated FDA manufacturing environment for the production and packing of [Product name masked] cards. The role involves operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting high-speed equipment, with regular contact with people across the plant floor.
cond_0492.responsibilities:
Complete Preventive and Corrective Maintenance work orders independently for the different equipment groups.
Inspect and maintain machines to prevent future failures or restore to serviceable and acceptable operating conditions.
Execute maintenance procedures, monitor operations, and record maintenance activities.
Trace errors within machine operations, check inputs and outputs, and document findings.
Check Measuring and Test Equipment (M&TE) to ensure accuracy, repeatability, and reproducibility — taking measurements in accordance with standardization procedures and cleaning and adjusting M&TE as needed.
Select and use appropriate M&TE to measure industrial equipment and component conditions in an accurate, repeatable, and reproducible manner, recording results.
Establish good documentation practices and follow proper procedures and techniques, including company and OSHA safety guidelines.
Use CMMs software correctly: complete PMs, enter urgent work orders, attach parts, attach labor, and search for parts.
Complete all scheduled training on time.
Navigate and find documents and drawings in the applicable system.
Support Total Productive Maintenance activities as an active participant, when applicable.
Stay accessible to people on the plant floor — regularly discussing problems and ideas with colleagues and being a reliable point of contact.
Maintain ongoing, collaborative relationships with Production, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Facilities Maintenance, communicating openly and proactively.
Work overtime as needed to ensure required labor resource needs are met.
Reliable attendance and punctuality is an essential job function required for this position.
cond_0492.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or GED with 10 years of work experience in a similar environment.
Good mechanical aptitude and knowledge of automation controls.
Knowledge of manufacturing equipment involving mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic hardware.
Knowledge of quality systems and FDA controls.
Computer skills: Word, Excel, ability to find documents in [Product name masked]/[Product name masked] and navigate the CMM system.
Ability to identify recurring problems on the manufacturing floor and determine corrective action to prevent them.
Preferred Requirements
Technical degree in a manufacturing technology discipline such as industrial controls and manufacturing processes.
Knowledge of and participation in Root Cause Analysis activity.
Advanced troubleshooting knowledge across all pieces of equipment in manufacturing.
